text: How would you store connections between cities so you can quickly look up all neighbours of any city?
A dictionary of dictionaries lets you write something like network['Mumbai']['Pune'] to get the edge data. This is called an adjacency dictionary.
To find the shortest path, you need to track the best-known distance to every city and always expand the cheapest unexplored city next. How do you efficiently find the minimum?
A priority queue always gives you the smallest item first. Python's heapq module provides exactly this heappush adds, heappop removes the smallest.

Dijkstra's algorithm: start at the source with cost 0, set all others to infinity. Pop the cheapest city, update its neighbours if you found a shorter path, push updated neighbours. Repeat until you reach the destination.
